description: This course covers the fundamentals of neural networks including perceptrons, multi-layer perceptrons, backpropagation algorithm, and activation functions such as ReLU and sigmoid. It delves into deep learning architectures like CNNs for image recognition, RNNs for sequence modeling, and GANs for generative modeling. The course also includes topics on optimization techniques such as stochastic gradient descent and Adam optimizer, and covers neural network training using frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch. It discusses standardization practices, including data normalization and validation techniques, and explores applications in natural language processing and computer vision.

clos.text: Define the architecture and components of a perceptron, including weights, bias, and activation functions.
Describe the mathematical formulation of backpropagation and its role in training multi-layer perceptrons.
Explain the principles of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and their application in image classification tasks.
Apply optimization algorithms such as Adam and stochastic gradient descent to train neural networks using TensorFlow.
Implement a generative adversarial network (GAN) for image generation using PyTorch.

topics: Introduction to Neural Networks and Perceptrons
Activation Functions and Their Impact on Network Performance
Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) and Sequence Modeling
Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Networks and Their Applications
Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Their Training Process
Deep Learning Frameworks: TensorFlow and PyTorch Overview
Advanced Techniques in Neural Network Training
Applications of Neural Networks in NLP and Computer Vision
Course Review and Final Project Preparation
